documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Un-Audited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026 And Conduct Of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: During FY 2025-26, Nitta Gelatin India Limited commissioned its new Collagen Peptide Project with an installed capacity of 3.5 metric tonnes per day, while its Gelatin Expansion Project progressed as per schedule. The company navigated trade uncertainties resulting from US tariff measures by focusing on market diversification, commercial strategies, and operational efficiency. Additionally, the Nitta Gelatin Group announced a Long-Term Management Vision in November 2025 targeting a doubling of net sales and a 2.5-fold increase in operating income by the fiscal year ending March 2033. Industry demand remained encouraging across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, and specialty applications. guidance.claim: The Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled a Long-Term Management Vision targeting double the net sales and a 2.5 times increase in operating income by the fiscal year ending March 2033.
guidance.quote: In November 2025, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled its Long-Term Management Vision, which sets an ambitious target of doubling net sales and increasing operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the gelatin industry remains encouraging due to rising demand across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, and specialty applications.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the gelatin industry also remains encouraging, supported by growing demand across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and specialty applications.

capex_expansion.claim: The ground-breaking ceremony for the collagen peptide expansion project was held on April 30, 2024, at Kakkanad, Kochi.
capex_expansion.quote: The Ground-Breaking ceremony (Bhumi Pooja) of your Company’s Collagen Peptide expansion project was held on April 30, 2024 at its factory located in Kakkanad, Kochi.

capex_expansion.claim: The collagen peptide expansion project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focusing on operational efficiency, market expansion, and risk management while monitoring global developments.
margins_costs.quote: We continue to closely monitor global developments while focusing on operational efficiency, market expansion and risk management.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed to declare a dividend on Equity Shares.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare dividend on Equity Shares.

risks_headwinds.claim: US tariff measures created heightened uncertainty in the global trade environment and impacted supply chains and trade flows.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year was marked by heightened uncertainty in the global trade environment following tariff measures introduced by the United States, which impacted international supply chains and trade flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, global trade flow volatility, and prospective US tariff expansion warrant continued operational caution.
risks_headwinds.quote: Notwithstanding the positive domestic outlook, uncertainties arising from geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, volatility in global trade flows and the potential continuation or expansion of tariff measures by major economies, including the United States, warrant continued caution.

management_commitments.claim: Nitta Gelatin Group aims to double net sales and increase operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.
management_commitments.quote: In November 2025, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled its Long-Term Management Vision, which sets an ambitious target of doubling net sales and increasing operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the collagen peptide expansion project to be commissioned by the middle of next year.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
